limitations: The exact find/sort/sha256sum pipeline runs in each terminal root and includes every regular file, including SEAL/FINALIZED and any FINALIZATION_ABORT.
Controller absence and regular FINALIZED presence checked before hashing; controller absence, marker byte hashes, and full entry stat fingerprints rechecked after hashing.
Read-atime effects excluded from unchanged-stat checks. This is not an atomic snapshot or independent model/scientific verification.
No tar creation, transfer, extraction, launch, kill, GPU query, replay, outcome scoring, Git operation, or repo edit. Main supplies archive pins and handles transfers.

Receipt captures the node environment locale without overriding it. ASCII printable, non-backslash filenames were checked to avoid sha256sum quoting ambiguity. Later archive verification must match these exact whole-root digests.

observation.hash_pipeline: find . -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
